primary_route: Separate optical, reporter and target kinetics with substrate titration and proposed independent product validation.

checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior target/reporter Methods, supplements or a validated protocol before execution and check transfer of detailed conditions.
Treats competitive versus noncompetitive/uncompetitive kinetic classes as active-site versus allosteric binding. Kinetic pattern alone does not establish structural binding location.
Reagent list and solubility check omit identity/purity and authenticated stock/activity integrity checks.
Km and linear-range instructions do not resolve buffer, pH, cofactors, enzyme amounts and temperature through an executable local calibration procedure.
One fixed fluorophore level and a >80% quench stop do not validate recovery/accuracy across the product and compound matrix; no acceptable corrected-standard recovery is specified.
No product standard conversion with amount/time units and complete weak/saturated/missing rate handling.
Wells are treated as independent units without independent preparation/day replication, nesting or a precision/power plan.
Randomized wells are given, but automatic extraction alone is not a blinded or prespecified equivalent control on fitting, window choice and mechanism interpretation.
No nested/run-level uncertainty, free-inhibitor assumption check or justified model discrimination; R-squared alone does not identify a mechanism.
Packet provides no IC50. No dose-pilot procedure supplies that prerequisite or locks the chosen grid/window before confirmation.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation following repaired conditions.
No equivalence/adequate-precision negative rule or ambiguous model decision; target substrate/product chemical alternatives remain unexcluded.
Independent detection is named as a fallback without operational target-product/quench/matrix/recovery validation.
No linked raw-file IDs, code/software versions and reproducible audit outputs.
Prospective vehicle, no-enzyme/no-substrate, reporter-only, fluorophore spikes and conditional known inhibitors have stated purposes.
Main question/evidence and time-dependent/optical alternatives addressed; specific statistical and assay attribution defects are charged in P checks only.
